title: Build with AI 2026
shortDescription: A series of hands-on Build with AI events run by ML Bhopal across 2026.
description: Build with AI 2026 is a series of hands-on Build with AI events run by ML Bhopal across 2026. Events in the series: NextGen Apps: Build With AI (Mar 28), AI Day Bhopal 2.0 | Build with AI (May 16, at LNCT), and Code Safe with AI: Build with AI (Sep 19). Details and registration for each event are on Commudle.
